description: This Scala source file defines the FlowProgressEventLogger class used for logging flow progress events in Apache Spark pipelines, managing flow states and logging levels based on flow statuses and execution modes.

classes.name: FlowProgressEventLogger
classes.description: A class for logging flow progress events, managing flow states, and controlling log levels based on flow statuses in Spark pipelines.

methods.name: recordQueued
methods.description: Logs an event indicating a flow has been queued, at INFO level.

methods.name: recordPlanningForBatchFlow
methods.description: Logs an event indicating a batch flow is in planning stage, at INFO level.

methods.name: recordStart
methods.description: Logs an event indicating a flow has started, at INFO level.

methods.name: recordRunning
methods.description: Logs an event indicating a flow is running, at INFO level.

methods.name: recordFailed
methods.description: Logs a failure event for a flow, at ERROR or WARN level based on parameter.

methods.name: recordSkippedOnUpStreamFailure
methods.description: Logs a skipped event due to upstream failure, at WARN level.

methods.name: recordSkipped
methods.description: Logs an event indicating a flow was skipped, at INFO level.

methods.name: recordExcluded
methods.description: Logs an event indicating a flow is excluded, at INFO level.

methods.name: recordStop
methods.description: Logs an event indicating a flow has stopped, at INFO level.

methods.name: recordIdle
methods.description: Logs an event indicating a flow is idle, waiting for data, at INFO level.

methods.name: recordCompletion
methods.description: Logs an event indicating a flow has completed, at INFO level.
